'''Crymi''' was a male [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[biochemist]]ry living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Carrick Station]], he managed a small shop, also teaching his knowledge to others.
